verdict.rationale: Bench is a software-plus-human bookkeeping SaaS with web and in-app surfaces, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics tracking, or any opt-out control. The security page covers only Plaid account connections, so the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
